Initial release: Easily convert meeting transcripts into actionable summaries.

- Extracts key decisions, action items with owners, and follow-up dates from transcripts.
- Provides a concise 3-sentence summary of each meeting.
- Outputs structured results in Markdown format.
- Supports input via file, clipboard, or inline text.
